feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.description: Tell us what is working, what is confusing, or what you want changed. This goes to the host's feedback channel, not an analytics service.
feedback.question: What is on your mind?
feedback.privacy: Submissions use a random per-message ID and never include your IP address or the page URL. An email is only included if you type one.
feedback.consentNote: Feedback can be sent even when analytics consent is denied; it is not tied to analytics tracking.
feedback.error: Could not send feedback. Your draft is preserved; please try again.
feedback.unconfigured: The feedback channel is not configured on this host, so submissions cannot be delivered. Contact the administrator.
